convergentPair.evaluatorOnlyHypothesis: Repeated exposure to dependable maintenance, preparation, coordination and shared systems may make practical reliability more salient than dramatic last-minute fixes, while leaving room for disagreement, ambivalence or no such durable meaning.
convergentPair.routeA: Sapporo offers recurring seasonal constraints around snow, winter movement, household timing and visible municipal road or snow-service coordination.
convergentPair.routeB: Kochi offers recurring constraints around waterways, mixed-mode journeys, transfers, household timing and later rail, water-metro or feeder-service coordination.
convergentPair.purpose: If a similar broad stance emerges, D1 should still discriminate the lived route, relationships, tensions and residue rather than reward a city label or conclusion phrase. Failure to converge is a result, not a generation defect.

raterDiscipline.independenceCaveat: Replicates are isolated stateless judgments, not independent model families. Target-level majority decisions, not all replicate calls, are the primary unit for cohort interpretation.

D1.name: life_attribution_raw_and_normalized
D1.question: Can a Thread's remembered self-account be matched to the particular underlying life that produced it, rather than to another final-cohort life?
D1.target: remembered memories plus current durable meanings, with no identity labels
D1.choices: the five anonymous underlying life histories
D1.primaryUnit: five Thread-level majority decisions per condition

interpretation.closureReading: Strong particularity supports #39's anti-interchangeability claim. Mixed is inconclusive and requires hostile-review judgment. Setting-dominated or weak particularity means the final cohort does not establish the intended differentiated-life claim and should default to redesign rather than resampling.

D1.uncertainty: Report all three replicate choices for every target, the 5-Thread majority accuracy, and the exact one-sided binomial tail against p=0.2 as descriptive context. Do not treat the 15 replicate calls as independent observations.

D2.name: sentiment_coupling
D2.question: Are remembered meanings suspiciously compressed into the emotional valence of the events they cite?
D2.measurement: Blind raters score each cited episode and each current durable meaning on an ordinal -2,-1,0,+1,+2 valence scale. For each meaning, cited-event valence is the median of its cited episodes; per-Thread coupling is Spearman rho across eligible meaning pairs.

interpretation.cohortHighConcern: at least 4 eligible Threads have absolute rho >= 0.70

D2.uncertainty: Threads with fewer than four eligible durable meanings are reported as insufficient-cell rather than imputed. Report per-Thread rho, eligible-pair count, cohort median absolute rho and leave-one-Thread-out range. This is characterization, not an admission quota.

D3.name: genome_propagation
D3.question: Does permitted genome exposure alter autobiographical retention without appearing in the clean life-only negative control?
D3.trial: For each remembered Pass-B output, blind raters receive only the remembered content and five anonymous final-genome semantic projections with IDs, provenance and assignment removed, then select the most compatible genome source.
D3.ceilingCheck: Before memory attribution, run five direct-visible calibration targets formed by a deterministic closureId-seeded selection of three actual loci from each final genome; each target is matched against the same five anonymous genome projections. All 5 Thread-level calibration targets must be majority-correct or D3 is instrument-invalid.
D3.aboveChanceRule: A cell is above chance only when it has at least 5 remembered trials, majority-vote accuracy >= 0.60, and a one-sided exact binomial p-value < 0.05 against p=0.20.
D3.nearCeilingRule: majority-vote accuracy >= 0.80 with at least 5 remembered trials and the above-chance rule satisfied

interpretation.intendedPropagation: life_plus_genome above chance AND life_only_unexposed not above chance
interpretation.noDetectedPropagation: life_plus_genome not above chance AND life_only_unexposed not above chance
interpretation.negativeControlFailure: life_only_unexposed above chance; this blocks a clean genome-propagation reading regardless of treatment performance and requires leakage or upstream-dependence investigation
interpretation.possibleOverDetermination: life_plus_genome and life_only_unexposed both near ceiling
interpretation.insufficientCell: fewer than 5 remembered trials in a cell; preserve the result and do not generate replacements

D3.uncertainty: Report remembered and not-remembered counts for every planned cell, target-level 3-rater votes, majority accuracy and exact binomial tail. Legal not_remembered outcomes reduce realized cell size and never trigger replacement generation.

D4.name: life_funnel
D4.question: How much of durable history becomes autobiographical memory and then durable remembered meaning?

interpretation.overplotConcern: at least 4/5 Threads remember all 6 Pass-B calls AND every remembered memory in those Threads has a current durable meaning
interpretation.reading: Forgetting and no-durable-meaning are legal. A fully saturated cohort is a narrative-overdetermination concern, not a reason to regenerate individual lives.

D4.uncertainty: Report exact counts and cohort distribution; do not convert the funnel into a pass/fail percentage target.

D5.name: self_account_overreach
D5.question: Does durable history contain material that the Thread's current remembered meanings do not accommodate?
D5.measurement: Blind raters receive one anonymous 14-episode history plus that Thread's current durable meanings. Each history episode is marked accommodated only when the supplied meanings textually support that reading; otherwise it is unaccommodated. Episode status uses 2-of-3 rater majority.

interpretation.historicalExcessObserved: at least one majority-unaccommodated history episode exists for the Thread
interpretation.cohortOverreachConcern: at least 4/5 Threads have zero majority-unaccommodated history episodes
interpretation.reading: Perfect or near-universal retrospective self-explanation across the cohort is suspiciously authored. There is no quota requiring each individual Thread to misunderstand itself.

D5.uncertainty: Report episode-level votes and counts. Raters must cite the supplied meaning text when marking an episode accommodated; unsupported psychological inference is not accommodation.

globalInterpretationRules: Diagnostics characterize the one final cohort; they do not admit or reject individual generated records.
No threshold may be changed after final output is read.
A weak but integrity-valid cohort is preserved and interpreted; it is never silently replaced.
A mechanical or substrate mechanism is never evidence for identity, memory, meaning or character.
Failure of D1 normalized particularity or a D3 clean negative control defaults to redesign or investigation, not rescue sampling.
Small-N results are reported with exact counts and target-level votes; no claim of population-level statistical power is made.
